entries.name: Kneeling Cable Crunch With Alternating Oblique Twists
entries.reason: Source-bound side-view draft with a spine that curls and shoulders that turn. Kneeling facing a high pulley with the rope ends beside the ears; three repetitions in one cycle, as the source orders them: a plain curl down until the elbows reach the knees, then one that turns as it goes down so one elbow travels toward the opposite knee, then the same to the other side, each followed by a slow rise. The hips do not move and the hands stay by the ears throughout. Seen from the side, the turn shows as one shoulder and elbow leading and the other trailing.
entries.summary: Kneeling facing a high pulley with the rope by the ears, curl down until the elbows reach the knees and rise slowly; on the next repetitions turn partway down so one elbow travels to the opposite knee, alternating sides.

frames.caption: Attach a rope to a high pulley, kneel facing it a short step back and hold the rope ends beside the ears.
Keeping the hands by the ears and the hips still, curl the torso down until the elbows reach the knees.
Rise slowly.
On the next repetition, turn partway down.
One elbow travels to the opposite knee.
Rise slowly.
Then repeat to the other side.
The other elbow travels to its opposite knee.
Rise slowly.
Hands stay by the ears. Curl the spine, hips still.

entries.name: Barbell Ab Rollout
entries.reason: Source-bound draft, drawn from a 3D model turned 14 degrees so the shoulder-width grip, the small plates rolling along the floor, the kneeling legs on the floor, and the tucked, anti-sag hip line all read clearly: kneeling behind the barbell, rolling forward as far as possible with straight arms and without the hips sagging below the knee-to-shoulder line, and pulling back to the knees with the trunk.
entries.summary: Kneeling behind a barbell loaded with small plates and gripped at shoulder width, brace hard and roll the bar forward as far as you can without your hips sagging, then pull the bar back to your knees using your abs.

frames.caption: Kneel behind a loaded barbell with small plates, grip it at shoulder width, and tuck the pelvis before you move.
Brace hard and roll the bar forward while reaching long with the elbows.
Roll the bar forward as far as you can without your hips sagging.
Pull the bar back towards your knees using your abs, not your arms.
Return the bar to your knees while keeping the trunk braced.

entries.name: Barbell Rollout from Bench
entries.reason: Source-bound draft, drawn from a 3D model turned 14 degrees so the knees elevated on the flat bench, the barbell with small plates rolling on the floor below the bench end, the straight arms, and the extending hips all contrast directly with Barbell Ab Rollout: kneeling on the bench with the bar on the floor at its end, rolling forward with straight arms until the arms reach overhead, and pulling the bar back under the shoulders.
entries.summary: Kneeling on a bench with a loaded barbell on the floor at the end of it and the hands about shoulder-width apart, keep the arms straight while the hips extend and the bar rolls forward until the arms reach overhead, then pull the bar back under the shoulders.

frames.caption: Place a loaded barbell on the floor at the end of a bench, kneel on the bench, and grip the bar with the hands about shoulder-width apart.
With the arms straight and the trunk braced, let the hips extend and roll the bar forward.
Roll the bar forward until the arms are reaching overhead as far as you can control.
Pull the bar back towards the bench with the trunk braced.
Pull the bar back under the shoulders to return to the start.
